scope.claim: one episode with two seed schedules; means are descriptive, not population estimates or confidence intervals
scope.comparison: endpoint prediction errors are relative to real trajectory frames under future-pose motion conditions
scope.h1: one G0 endpoint per schedule; TF and AR mode-specific endpoints start at h2
scope.horizons: five observed generated-chunk endpoints only; line segments are visual guides, not fitted growth laws
scope.latent: condition-mask RMS/error geometry uses image-condition latent mask slots; future poses are action conditions
scope.mse_identity: observed AR-minus-TF MSE difference equals the FP64 cross term plus feedback-change squared, up to the recorded identity residual
